notes: Assumptions that change the number: oxtail 45 % edible meat and fat by weight (bone is the rest), at the UK CoFID raw oxtail value because SR Legacy has none; skimming the fat off at the end is not deducted, though it takes off perhaps 20–40 kcal a serving; ~20 g of the dusting flour stays on; stock made from a cube at 3 kcal / 100 g. Sanity check: Sainsbury's Magazine oxtail stew is 514 kcal a serving (serves 6–8), Jo Cooks is 729 kcal (serves 6) and African Bites is 762 kcal (serves 4). Ours, at 490, is within 5 % of Sainsbury's. The higher two list 74–80 g protein a serving, which only fits if the whole oxtail weight, bones included, is counted as meat. Our 38 g protein is what 170 g of raw edible oxtail gives.
